prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of the fishing town of Getaria, Basque Country, Spain, at night. IMPORTANT: no invented floodlighting — an honest night treatment. The town lies mostly dark on the rocky cape, with scattered warm windows and harbor streetlights; the Mount San Antón (El Ratón) lighthouse throws its beam across the water; the fishing port glows softly with dock lamps; moonlight on the Bay of Biscay. San Salvador church silhouette. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
